path, enables WAL mode,\n303\t// and applies any pending migrations.\n304\tfunc OpenDB(path string) (*DB, error) {\n305\t\tdb, err := sql.Open(\"sqlite\", path)\n306\t\tif err != nil {\n307\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"open sqlite %q: %w\", path, err)\n308\t\t}\n309\t\n310\t\t// SQLite works best with a single writer connection.\n311\t\tdb.SetMaxOpenConns(1)\n312\t\n313\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;\"); err != nil {\n314\t\t\tdb.Close()\n315\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable WAL: %w\", err)\n316\t\t}\n317\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;\"); err != nil {\n318\t\t\tdb.Close()\n319\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable foreign keys: %w\", err)\n320\t\t}\n321\t\n322\t\td := &DB{db: db}\n323\t\tif err := d.migrate(); err != nil {\n324\t\t\tdb.Close()\n325\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"migrate: %w\", err)\n326\t\t}\n327\t\treturn d, nil\n328\t}\n329\t\n330\t// Close closes the underlying database connection.\n331\tfunc (d *DB) Close() error {\n332\t\treturn d.db.Close()\n333\t}\n334\t\n335\t// SqlDB returns the underlying *sql.DB for use with other packages.\n336\tfunc (d *DB) SqlDB() *sql.DB {\n337\t\treturn d.db\n338\t}\n339\t\n340\t// migrate creates the schema_version table if needed, then applies any\n341\t// migrations whose version number exceeds the current schema version.\n342\tfunc (d *DB) migrate() error {\n343\t\t_, err := d.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (\n344\t\t\tversion    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n345\t\t\tapplied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n346\t\t);`)\n347\t\tif err != nil {\n348\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create schema_version: %w\", err)\n349\t\t}\n350\t\n351\t\tvar current int\n352\t\trow := d.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version`)\n353\t\tif err := row.Scan(&current); err != nil {\n354\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"read schema_version: %w\", err)\n355\t\t}\n356\t\n357\t\tfor i, ddl := range migrations {\n358\t\t\tversion := i + 1\n359\t\t\tif version <= current {\n360\t\t\t\tcontinue\n361\t\t\t}\n362\t\n363\t\t\ttx, err := d.db.Begin()\n364\t\t\tif err != nil {\n365\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"begin migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n366\t\t\t}\n367\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(ddl); err != nil {\n368\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n369\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"apply migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n370\t\t\t}\n371\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n372\t\t\t\t`INSERT INTO schema_version (version) VALUES (?)`, version,\n373\t\t\t); err != nil {\n374\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n375\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"record migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n376\t\t\t}\n377\t\t\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n378\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"commit migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n379\t\t\t}\n380\t\t}\n381\t\treturn nil\n382\t}\n383\t\n384\t// ── groups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n385\t\n386\t// GetGroup returns the group with the AND thread_id = ?`, chatID, threadID)\n\treturn scanSession(row)\n}\n\n// CreateSession inserts a new session record.\nfunc (d *DB) CreateSession(ctx context.Context, s *Session) error {\n\tnow := time.Now().UTC()\n\tif s.CreatedAt.IsZero() {\n\t\ts.CreatedAt = now\n\t}\n\tif s.LastActive.IsZero() {\n\t\ts.LastActive = now\n\t}\n\tif s.Status == \"\" {\n\t\ts.Status = \"active\"\n\t}\n\tif s.IconColor == 0 {\n\t\ts.IconColor = 7322096 // Default to light blue (0x6FB9F0)\n\t}\n\tif s.NotificationMode == \"\" {\n\t\ts.NotificationMode = \"live\"\n\t}\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`INSERT INTO sessions\n\t\t   (chat_id, thread_id, session_id, cwd, model, status, icon_color, created_at, last_active, message_count, pinned_message_id, total_cost_usd, summary, notification_mode, timeout_sec)\n\t\t VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n\t\ts.ChatID, s.ThreadID, s.SessionID, s.CWD, nullableString(s.Model), s.Status,\n\t\ts.IconColor,\n\t\ts.CreatedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.LastActive.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.MessageCount,\n\t\ts.PinnedMessageID,\n\t\ts.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\tnullableString(s.Summary),\n\t\ts.NotificationMode,\n\t\ts.TimeoutSec,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// UpdateSession updates mutable fields on an existing session.\nfunc (d *DB) UpdateSession(ctx context.Context, s *Session) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`UPDATE sessions\n\t\t SET session_id    = ?,\n\t\t     cwd           = ?,\n\t\t     model         = ?,\n\t\t     status        = ?,\n\t\t     icon_color    = ?,\n\t\t     last_active   = ?,\n\t\t     message_count = ?,\n\t\t     pinned_message_id = ?,\n\t\t     total_cost_usd    = ?,\n\t\t     summary           = ?,\n\t\t     notification_mode = ?,\n\t\t     timeout_sec       = ?,\n\t\t     dispatcher_mode   = ?\n\t\t WHERE chat_id = ? AND thread_id = ?`,\n\t\ts.SessionID, s.CWD, nullableString(s.Model), s.Status,\n\t\ts.IconColor,\n\t\ts.LastActive.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.MessageCount,\n\t\ts.PinnedMessageID,\n\t\ts.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\tnullableString(s.Summary),\n\t\ts.NotificationMode,\n\t\ts.TimeoutSec,\n\t\ts.DispatcherMode,\n\t\ts.ChatID, s.ThreadID,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// SetSessionIconColor updates only the icon_color field for a session.\nfunc (d *DB) SetSessionIconColor(ctx context.Context, chatID, threadID int64, color int) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`UPDATE sessions SET icon_color = ? WHERE chat_id = ? AND thread_id = ?`,\n\t\tnullableString(summary), chatID, threadID,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\ntype sessionScanner interface {\n\tScan(dest ...any) error\n}\n\nfunc scanSession(s sessionScanner) (*Session, error) {\n\tvar sess Session\n\tvar createdAt, lastActive string\n\terr := s.Scan(\n\t\t&sess.ChatID, &sess.ThreadID, &sess.SessionID, &sess.CWD,\n\t\t&sess.Model, &sess.Status, &createdAt, &lastActive, &sess.MessageCount, &sess.IconColor,\n\t\t&sess.PinnedMessageID, &sess.TotalCostUSD, &sess.Summary, &sess.NotificationMode, &sess.TimeoutSec,\n\t\t&sess.DispatcherMode,\n\t)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tsess.CreatedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, createdAt)\n\tsess.LastActive, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, lastActive)\n\tif sess.NotificationMode == \"\" {\n\t\tsess.NotificationMode = \"live\"\n\t}\n\treturn &sess, nil\n}\n\n// ── allowed_users ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n// IsUserAllowed returns true if userID is in the allowed_users table.\nfunc (d *DB) IsUserAllowed(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (bool, error) {\n\tvar count int\n\terr := d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID,\n\t).Scan(&count)\n\treturn count > 0, err\n}\n\n// GetUserRole returns the role for a user (\"admin\" or \"user\").\n// Returns empty string if user not found.\nfunc (d *DB) GetUserRole(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (string, error) {\n\tvar role string\n\terr := d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT role FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID,\n\t).Scan(&role)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn \"\", nil\n\t}\n\treturn role, err\n}\n\n// IsUserAdmin returns true if the user has an \"admin\" role.\nfunc (d *DB) IsUserAdmin(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (bool, error) {\n\trole, err := d.GetUserRole(ctx, userID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn false, err\n\t}\n\treturn role == \"admin\", nil\n}\n\n// GetAllowedUser returns the allowed user record, or (nil, nil) if not found.\nfunc (d *DB) GetAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (*AllowedUser, error) {\n\trow := d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT user_id, role, added_at FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID)\n\n\tvar u AllowedUser\n\tvar addedAt string\n\terr := row.Scan(&u.UserID, &u.Role, &addedAt)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tu.AddedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, addedAt)\n\treturn &u, nil\n}\n\n// UpsertAllowedUser inserts or updates an allowed user.\nfunc (d *DB) UpsertAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, u *AllowedUser) error {\n\tif u.AddedAt.IsZero() {\n\t\tu.AddedAt = time.Now().UTC()\n\t}\n\tif u.Role == \"\" {\n\t\tu.Role = \"user\"\n\t}\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`INSERT INTO allowed_users (user_id, role, added_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n\t\t ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role`,\n\t\tu.UserID, u.Role, u.AddedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// DeleteAllowedUser removes a user from the allow list.\nfunc (d *DB) DeleteAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, userID int64) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`DELETE FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// ListAllowedUsers returns all allowed users ordered by added_at.\nfunc (d *DB) ListAllowedUsers(ctx context.Context) ([]*AllowedUser, error) {\n\trows, err := d.db.QueryContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT user_id, role, added_at FROM allowed_users ORDER BY added_at`)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdefer rows.Close()\n\n\tvar users []*AllowedUser\n\tfor rows.Next() {\n\t\tvar u AllowedUser\n\t\tvar addedAt string\n\t\tif err := rows.Scan(&u.UserID, &u.Role, &addedAt); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tu.AddedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, addedAt)\n\t\tusers = append(users, &u)\n\t}\n\treturn users, rows.Err()\n}\n\n// EnsureAdminUser ensures a user exists as an admin in the database.\n// If the user doesn't
